title: onX Hunt Property Boundary Near-Miss Alerts
dataSources: Catch trips (`outdoor:trip`), hunt map activity (`hunt:map`), foraging observations (`forage:observation`), smoker sessions (`cook:smoker`), harvest queues (`outdoor:queue`).
app: Fishing, hunting, foraging, and outdoor-cooking telemetry — Fishbrain catch logs, onX Hunt map exports, iNaturalist observations, and ThermoWorks smoker probes — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=hunt:map property_name=* near_miss=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(near_miss="yes",1,0))) as matched by property_name
| eval a_boundary_near_miss_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - a_boundary_near_miss_pct
description: Measures the percentage of hunt-map traversals that end with a boundary near miss by property.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which property are helping or hurting hunt-map traversals.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `a boundary near miss` on `hunt:map` events and summarize the hit rate by `property_name`.
visualization: Table of property with percentage of hunt-map traversals ending with a boundary near miss.
grandmaExplanation: It lists how often a boundary near miss happens for each property so you can see where hunt-map traversals go smoothly or get stuck.
